judgment.reason: It uses the correct totient formula and correctly derives \(S(n)\equiv-n/p\pmod p\), yielding precisely the square-free integers.
The modular residue-class argument and correct totient formula establish the square-free characterization completely.
It correctly proves, for every prime divisor \(p\), that \(p\mid S(n)\) exactly when \(p^2\mid n\).
